title: Electrical Services
description: From new circuit wiring to fixing a tripped breaker, our licensed electricians handle residential and commercial electrical work across Kampala safely and to code. We diagnose faults quickly, install lighting and power points cleanly, and leave every job site tidy.
process: Written quote before any work starts
Work carried out with safety isolation
desc: Wiring, lighting installation, repairs and maintenance carried out safely by trained technicians.

title: Plumbing Services
description: Leaking pipes, blocked drains, or a full bathroom re-plumb — our plumbers fix it right the first time. We work on homes, offices, and commercial properties, using durable fittings built for Kampala's water conditions.
benefits: Rapid response to leaks and blockages
process: Inspect the plumbing issue on site
Explain the fix and confirm cost
desc: Pipe installation, plumbing repairs, drainage systems and water system maintenance.

title: Masonry Works
description: Whether it's a new boundary wall, a concrete slab, or repairing cracked plaster, our masonry teams bring construction-grade craftsmanship to every job, managed properly from materials to finish.
process: Provide a detailed materials & labour quote
Execute the masonry work in phases
desc: Bricklaying, concrete works, plastering and renovations handled by skilled teams.

title: Carpentry
description: Custom cabinetry, door and window framing, furniture assembly and repair — our carpenters combine precision joinery with finishes built to last in Uganda's climate.
desc: Furniture installation, cabinet works, door and window framing, and wood finishing.

title: Welding & Fabrication
description: From security gates and burglar-proofing to structural steelwork, our welders fabricate and repair metalwork built for durability, matched to your property's design.
desc: Metal gates, security doors, structural fabrication and welding repairs.

title: Painting & Finishing
description: A fresh coat of paint transforms a space and protects it from Kampala's weather. We prep surfaces properly, use quality paints, and deliver a clean, even finish inside and out.
process: Inspect surfaces and agree on colours
desc: Interior and exterior painting with decorative finishes that protect and refresh every space.

title: CCTV Installation
description: See what matters, from anywhere. We design and install CCTV coverage tailored to your property's layout, with remote monitoring on your phone and footage you can rely on.
process: Survey the property for coverage points
Recommend a camera layout and quote
Set up remote access and hand over
desc: Professionally installed CCTV systems with remote viewing for homes and businesses.

title: Security Systems
description: Beyond cameras, we install alarm systems, access control and integrated security setups that protect your home or business around the clock.
benefits: Access control for gates and doors
Integration with smart locks and CCTV
desc: Alarm systems, access control and integrated security for total peace of mind.

title: Smart Homes
description: Turn your home into a connected, modern living space. We install and configure smart lighting, smart locks, and automation systems that work together from a single app.
benefits: Works alongside your CCTV and alarms
process: Discuss which rooms and routines to automate
Train you on the app and routines
desc: Home automation that connects lighting, locks, and security into one smart system.

title: Cleaning Services
description: A clean space is a functional one. We offer deep cleaning and regular maintenance cleaning for homes, offices, and commercial properties, on a schedule that suits you.
benefits: One-off deep cleans or recurring visits
process: Tell us the space and frequency needed
Receive a cleaning schedule and quote
desc: Thorough home and office cleaning, one-off or on a regular schedule.

title: Landscaping
description: From lawn care to full garden design, we shape outdoor spaces that complement your property and are easy to maintain year-round.
process: Propose a design or maintenance plan
Set up an ongoing care schedule
desc: Garden design, lawn care and outdoor space maintenance.

title: Interior Design
description: We help homes and businesses plan interiors that work — layout, finishes, and fittings chosen to match how the space is actually used, delivered alongside our construction teams.
process: Understand how the space will be used
desc: Interior spaces planned and finished to feel professional, modern, and functional.

title: Pest Control
description: Termites, rodents, or general pest prevention — we treat the problem safely and advise on keeping it from coming back.
benefits: Treatment for termites, rodents and insects
process: Inspect the property for pest activity
desc: Safe, effective pest treatment for homes and businesses.

title: Air Conditioning
description: New AC installation, routine servicing, or a unit that's stopped cooling — our technicians install and maintain air conditioning systems for homes and offices.
process: Assess the space and cooling needs
Recommend a unit or service plan
Install or service the AC unit
desc: AC installation, servicing and repair to keep your space comfortable.
